banglaExplanation: Evidence মানে দক্ষতার প্রমাণ, আর এর দুইটা ধরন আছে।
Direct evidence: assessor নিজে সামনে দেখেন বা শোনেন, যেমন demonstration বা oral questioning।
Indirect evidence: candidate-এর কাজ পরে যাচাই করে দেখা হয়, যেমন finished product বা written test।
পরীক্ষায় প্রায়ই জিজ্ঞেস করে কোনটা direct আর কোনটা indirect, তাই উদাহরণগুলো মুখস্থ রাখুন।

example.bn: Assessor সামনে দাঁড়িয়ে সেলাই দেখলে direct evidence; সুপারভাইজারের রিপোর্ট পড়লে indirect evidence।
example.en: An assessor watches a garments trainee sew a shirt. That is direct evidence. A supervisor's report on the trainee is indirect evidence.

short.modelAnswer:
There are two forms of evidence:
1. Direct evidence: observed or witnessed by the assessor. Examples: observation of work activities, oral questioning, demonstration of specific skills.
2. Indirect evidence: the candidate's work reviewed or examined by the assessor. Examples: finished product, written test of underpinning knowledge, review of previous work, testimonials or reports from employers, evidence of training.

viva.prompt: Is a finished product direct or indirect evidence?

realQuestions.answer:
Forms of Evidence:
Direct Evidence is evidence that can be observed or witnessed by the assessor.
This may include
•
Observations by the assessors of the candidate carrying out work activities
•
Oral questioning of the candidate
•
Demonstration of specific skills needed to complete the task
Indirect evidence is evidence of the candidate's work that can be reviewed or
examined by the assessor. This may include,
•
Assessment of finished product
•
Written test of underpinning knowledge
•
Review of previous work performed
•
Testimonials or reports from employers, colleagues, clients or supervisors
•
Evidence of training
realQuestions.label: CBLM 12 Self Check 1 (Q6)
realQuestions.question: What are the different forms of evidence?

realQuestions.answer:
Direct evidence is observed firsthand by the assessor, such as
performing a task or demonstration. Indirect evidence is obtained by reviewing
work products or other records, such as a finished product, written test, prior work
or testimonial.
realQuestions.label: Short Questions (Short 67)
realQuestions.question: Explain the two forms of evidence used in competency assessment.

realQuestions.answer:
Any four: assessment of a finished product; a written test of
underpinning knowledge; review of prior work; an employer/supervisor
testimonial; or training evidence.
